steps.why: The conversation the run was started from, while the run is parked at the SKILLS RECOMMENDATION and nothing has been pressed.

cells.requires: SECTION V of the ratified drawing at the contract's pin, verbatim: 'Where the assistant proposes the skills it means to use, the turn carries a chip-row: one chip per skill, each carrying its own Confirm, Adjust and Skip, so the reader shapes the run one skill at a time before it runs.' and 'The row is the whole card. There is no heading plate above it and no row-level submit beneath it — nothing states the question a second time, and nothing decides every skill at once. A skill is settled by pressing one of its own three affordances, and each chip then shows what it recorded.'
